_note: Prefilter knobs that are not in solada/paper.json. Rule thresholds (k, y, aa, kill lines) are read from solada/paper.json and solada/log.json at runtime.

rule_defaults._note: Pinned numeric k/y thresholds used only when parsing solada/paper.json rules prose fails (logged as a warning).

kill_dedupe._note: Kill lines dedupe on ticker + crossed metric names. Re-fire only when a value is refire_deeper_pct% below the last reported value; recovery needs recover_runs consecutive full-data runs back above the line by recover_margin_pct%.

webhook._note: Idempotency-Key = hash(run slot of this many minutes + trigger keys).

whale._stake_note: Public third-party key of $cockwhale (founder whale), not the owner's. Listed in scripts/privacy-public-keys.txt so the privacy guard allows this exact value; output carries only its tag.

dust._note: A whale move's % of position is reported (and can trigger) only when the move is worth >= pct_min_ada ADA and >= pct_min_qty whole tokens; smaller moves are marked dust (e.g. 0.75 STRIKE = 6.4% of a 12-token leftover).

units._note: Tracked tickers that are not Solada launches (or have copycats): unit = policy id + asset name hex.

lp_policies._note: DEX LP-token policy IDs (extends valuation.DEFAULT_LP_POLICIES). LP mints/burns are labelled LP and never count as whale buys or buy flags.

flags._note: FLAG-ONLY signals (flags.py). Never count toward rules k/y/aa or kill lines; never fire the webhook alone. Loose defaults; Snek reviews flags.json daily.

snek_prefix_tags._note: Snek Sentinel's stake-prefix tags (partial stake keys after 'stake1', already public in desk data). Seed watchlist only; newly found wallets are published as w-xxxxxxxx hashes.

flags._exclude_tags_note: Tags (w-xxxxxxxx = sha256 of the stake key or address) left out of holder_concentration / concentration_jump and the early-buyer cluster flags: protocol wallets, not holders. w-f46e5a31 = Solada curve reserve (Snek, Oct 26). Map tag -> label.

geckoterminal._note: Free API is ~30 calls/min per IP, shared with other jobs on the runner. 429s retry with backoff (Retry-After honoured, capped); after max_429_failures failed lookups GT is skipped for the rest of the run (DexScreener fallback). Lookups are cached per unit within a run.

big_moves._note: SPD-43 big-move detector (big_moves.py). Research rows only: never triggers, never the webhook. Free Koios public tier (5k req/day, 100 req/10s): max_calls per run, utxo_batch hashes per POST (1 KB body limit). budget_s is the slice earlier jobs must leave for this one. The job may also use slack before the liquidity reserve. max_calls stays 80.

whale_ledger._note: SPD-44 founder whale ledger (whale_ledger.py). Research only, never triggers or the webhook. Free Koios public tier: max_calls per run, utxo_batch hashes per POST, max_txs per run (backlog resumes next run). budget_s is the slice it runs first inside the shared research deadline, so big_moves cannot exhaust that deadline before the ledger (PR #31).

dev_checks._note: Phase 1 dev checks (dev_checks.py). budget_s is configurable (180). max_calls stays 36 and max_bf_calls stays 50: Koios first, Blockfrost fallback via the existing BLOCKFROST_PROJECT_ID, pace under 10/s. The primary webhook fires before this budget. The scan runs after that post and yields first if run start + 720s cannot also hold the whale, big_moves and liquidity reserves. A Koios 429 stops Koios here and pauses it for ~60s, then Koios resumes; the breaker is not tripped. On a Koios outage each scanned row gets about 8 Blockfrost calls (newest transactions first). Rows that do not fit that floor are marked budget and picked up on a later run. A new dev sell (unseen sell tx, changed_since_last) on a tracked token may add one dev_sell trigger, posted after the scan and independent of whether every row finished. Unchanged state does not re-fire. Rows are keyed by policy + asset name. min_sell_ada is a dust floor. Curve reserve stays in flags.exclude_tags and is left out of holder and seller logic. dev_buy_ada, dev_locked_pct and unlock_date are phase 2 (always null). LP pulls are liquidity_moves.py. fresh_funded_h (24) is a caution flag, not a veto: the dev wallet's first tx is within that many hours of launch. One Koios account_txs (oldest) per stake, Blockfrost /accounts/{stake}/transactions only when Koios fails, inside these same caps. A missing read stays null.

liquidity_moves._note: SPD-55 pool reserves for Snek cardano_top10 (liquidity_moves.py). Research only: no webhook, no desk rule, no kill line. Runs after whale_ledger and big_moves. budget_s (50) is reserved inside the run-start + 720s cap, and the slice also gets that many seconds from the moment it starts if an earlier slice already spent the reserve. A late window stops at run start + 770s (10s before the 780s process kill). Koios max_calls 36 per run (1 tip + one asset_txs page per pool marker + tx_info batches under 1 KB). Blockfrost only when a Koios read fails, max_bf_calls 12. A short window reads least-recently-checked tokens first (private cache last_checked). A budget skip is not stamped, so the rest of the top 10 is read on later runs. budget_s and max_calls are not raised. min_swap_ada / min_lp_ada are event floors. ahead_of_dump is the Balanced block below.

ahead_of_dump._note: Balanced floors. A pull counts only at or above pull_reserve_pct of the pool reserve (ADA before the pull) and pull_min_ada. ahead_of_dump is set only when sells from that same party (same w- hash or same dev/role tag) inside window_h total at least sell_of_pull_pct of the pulled ADA.

vetoes._note: SPD-65 research vetoes (vetoes.py). Derived from dev_checks.json and liquidity_moves.json after those jobs, no chain calls. Never a buy signal, never a webhook, never a desk rule or kill line. lp_pulled is a dev or role lp_remove. ahead_of_dump is its own code: a pull that meets liquidity_moves.ahead_of_dump (20% of reserve and 2,000 ADA, same-party sell 25% inside 6h). A loose flag does not count. counts is the per-code total. Each ahead_of_dump veto has a reason with those amounts only. max_age_h (5, about two 2h runs) drops a source whose at is older than that; a corrupt source keeps the previous vetoes.json. Evidence is tags only. fresh_funded is a dev_checks caution flag, not a code here. enabled can turn the file off. None of this changes desk floors.

rugger_blacklist._note: SPD-77 shared rugger list (rugger_blacklist). Private Actions-cache file rugger-blacklist.json, never desk-data. hops is 1. expiry_days null means no expiry. shared_funder_min 25: a funder with at least that many distinct funded wallets does not spread a taint, and neither does an excluded shared funder. Exclusions are raw wallets in the private store only, never in this file. known_rugger and known_rugger_funded are hard research vetoes on the Cardano desk. The Solana desk logs them and does not change entries or exits. buy_signal stays false.

_research_budget_note: Doc-only. Not read by job_deadline or research_deadline. Sum of the reserved whale_ledger + big_moves + liquidity_moves slices (90+150+50). dev_checks.budget_s (180) sits outside this sum and runs after the primary webhook. big_moves may also use slack before the liquidity reserve. dev_checks, whale_ledger and big_moves stop at run start + 720s. liquidity_moves keeps its own budget_s from the moment it starts and stops by run start + 770s. The process is killed at 780s and the workflow job is 20 minutes, leaving about 420s for checkout, tests, cache, the privacy guard, and the commit/push retries.
